prompt:
First real error in this snippet:
<concept id="x"><title>Assets & workflow</title></concept>
options: Raw ampersand in text — not well-formed
Missing shortdesc is a schema error in all DITA
why: A raw & breaks well-formedness. Shortdesc is often optional. Title is required and present.

options: A task body with a lone p and no steps is the wrong model for a procedure
why: Procedures belong in steps/cmd. A paragraph is not a task. The other two claims are false.

prompt: First real error in a map topicref href="Topics/Hello Concept.dita" when the file is topics/hello-concept.dita
options: href is case- and space-sensitive; this will miss on most systems
You must use an AEM path
why: File naming rules: lowercase hyphens. Mixed case and spaces break silently on some servers.

prompt: Goal: append a child topic to a map node.
options: DITA Maps Manager → right-click node → Append Child → Reference
why: Append Child lives on the map node in Maps Manager. Verify the label in your version.

prompt: Goal: create a DITA concept with a toolbar.
why: The New wizard template attaches the DITA framework. A blank XML file will not.

prompt: Goal: check the book for missing hrefs and keys.
options: Maps Manager → Validate and Check for Completeness
why: Completeness is a map action, not a topic-only validate.

prompt: WebHelp built but a topic is missing from the TOC. First place you look?
why: If it is not in the map, it will not be in the book. Completeness first.

prompt: PDF transform failed. First place you look?
options: The transformation log for the first error
why: Read the log. The first error is usually a missing file, invalid map, or engine path.

prompt: keyref shows as unresolved in Author. First place you look?
options: Root map setting, then the keydef
why: Keys resolve from the root map. No root map, no keys.
